title: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000
question:
What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011 and Reputation > 1000), COUNT(Id) ) * 100;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.XCL_053 > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011'
